item.title: Nish's Daily Reads — 2026-08-05
item.description: I opened three strong candidates from a pool of 232. The clearest signal was not a new model launch. It was money moving around the infrastructure and feedback needed to make AI useful: Anthropic is buying more computing power, and human taste is becoming a paid input for model builders. I dropped the rest rather than pad the page with claims I could not check in a primary source.
